steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Film music uses leitmotifs (recurring themes for characters/ideas) — Williams' Star Wars themes are textbook examples of orchestral leitmotif technique. | Key Fact: Underscoring supports the on-screen action without dominating; hit points sync musical events with dramatic moments on screen. | Key Fact: Gaming music must be INTERACTIVE — it adapts to player actions through horizontal resequencing or vertical layering, unlike linear film scores. | Key Fact: Modern film/gaming scores blend orchestral instruments with synthesisers, sampled sounds and electronic production — hybrid scoring is now the norm.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Describe how film and computer gaming music 1990s-present are used in a piece of music you have studied. Explain the effect in each case. | How could you use film and computer gaming music 1990s-present in your own composition or performance? Explain your choices.
